name: CreateSecretParameter

parameters.help_en: The name of the parameter. The name must be 1 to 180 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). It cannot start with ALIYUN, ACS, ALIBABA, ALICLOUD, or OOS
parameters.help_zh: 参数名称。取值范围：内容限制为字母、数字、中划线、下划线，长度不能超过180字符，且不能以ALIYUN、ACS、ALIBABA、ALICLOUD、OOS开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The type of the parameter. Set the value to Secret
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The value of the encryption parameter. The value must be 1 to 4096 characters in length
parameters.name: value

parameters.help_en: The description of the encryption parameter. The description must be 1 to 200 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 要给参数添加的描述信息。长度限制为200字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The key ID of Key Management Service (KMS) that is used to encrypt the parameter
parameters.name: key_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can be up to 64 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). For more information, see "How to ensure idempotence"
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求的幂等性。该值由客户端生成，并且必须是全局唯一的。
长度不超过64个字符，可包含英文字母、数字、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。
更多详情，请参见如何保证幂等性
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The constraints of the encryption parameter. By default, this parameter is null. Valid values:

AllowedValues: The value that is allowed for the encryption parameter. It must be an array string.
AllowedPattern: The pattern that is allowed for the encryption parameter. It must be a regular expression.
MinLength: The minimum length of the encryption parameter.
MaxLength: The maximum length of the encryption parameter
parameters.help_zh:
参数的约束条件，默认为空，取值范围：

AllowedValues  参数允许值，数组类型的字符串

AllowedPattern  正则字符串

MinLength  参数最小长度

MaxLength  参数最大长度
parameters.name: constraints

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the KMS instance
parameters.name: dkms_instance_id
